# pdfn

> Write PDF templates as React components. Server-side, Chromium-based PDF generation with predictable pagination, headers, footers, and Tailwind support.

## Overview

- [README](/README.md): Full documentation, examples, and API reference
- [Live Demo](https://pdfn.dev/#preview): Interactive preview

## Guides

- [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started.md): Installation and first PDF
- [Styling](/docs/styling.md): Inline styles, CSS props, Tailwind
- [Next.js](/docs/nextjs.md): App Router integration and deployment

## Packages

- [@pdfn/react](/packages/react/README.md): Core components and render/generate functions
- [@pdfn/tailwind](/packages/tailwind/README.md): Tailwind CSS support
- [@pdfn/next](/packages/next/README.md): Next.js edge runtime plugin
- [@pdfn/vite](/packages/vite/README.md): Vite edge runtime plugin
- [pdfn CLI](/packages/cli/README.md): Dev server with live preview

## Quick Reference

### Installation

```bash
# React projects
npm i @pdfn/react

# Plain Node.js
npm i react react-dom @pdfn/react

# With Tailwind
npm i @pdfn/tailwind
```

### Basic Example

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { Document, Page, PageNumber, generate } from '@pdfn/react';

function Invoice() {
  return (
    <Document title="Invoice">
      <Page size="A4" margin="1in" footer={<PageNumber />}>
        <h1 style={{ fontSize: 24 }}>Invoice #001</h1>
        <p>Total: $148.00</p>
      </Page>
    </Document>
  );
}

async function main() {
  const pdf = await generate(<Invoice />);
}
main();
```

> **Note:** `generate()` requires either `PDFN_HOST` (local dev server) or `PDFN_API_KEY` (pdfn Cloud). Use `render()` + Puppeteer to self-host with full control.

### Components

| Component | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `<Document>` | Root wrapper with metadata, fonts, CSS |
| `<Page>` | Page container with size, margins, header/footer |
| `<PageNumber>` | Current page number |
| `<TotalPages>` | Total page count |
| `<PageBreak>` | Force page break |
| `<NoBreak>` | Keep content together |
| `<Thead>` | Repeating table header (repeats by default) |

### Functions

| Function | Returns | Requires |
|----------|---------|----------|
| `render()` | HTML string | Nothing (self-host with your own Chromium) |
| `generate()` | PDF buffer | `PDFN_HOST` (local) or `PDFN_API_KEY` (Cloud) |

**pdfn is fully self-hostable.** Both functions produce identical layout. Choose based on infrastructure:
- `render()` → You manage Chromium (Puppeteer, Playwright, etc.)
- `generate()` → Local dev server or pdfn Cloud

### Compliance (pdfn Cloud only)

PDF/A and PDF/UA compliance require post-processing (validation, metadata, color profiles), provided by pdfn Cloud:

```tsx
// Works everywhere
const pdf = await generate(<Invoice />);

// Requires pdfn Cloud
const pdf = await generate(<Invoice />, { standard: 'PDF/A-2b' });
```

### Project Structure

Templates are stored in the `pdfn-templates/` folder by convention:

```
your-project/
├── pdfn-templates/           # PDF templates (convention)
│   ├── styles.css            # Tailwind theme (optional)
│   ├── styles/               # Plain CSS files
│   │   └── contract.css
│   ├── invoice.tsx
│   └── contract.tsx
└── ...
```

### Styling Options

1. **Inline styles** - `style={{ fontSize: 24 }}`
2. **CSS prop** - `<Document css={\`.class { ... }\`}>`
3. **Tailwind** - `<Tailwind>` wrapper with `pdfn-templates/styles.css`
